FAQ.description: What founders and business owners ask before bringing Masons onto a build.

q1.question: How do you work with clients?
q1.answer: We start with a focused scoping call around your revenue goals and constraints, then lock a clear milestone plan. You get live staging links, weekly demos, and open access to the engineers shipping your product.

q2.question: What technology stack do you use?
q2.answer: We choose proven tools based on your product goals, timeline, and budget. Our day-to-day toolkit spans Next.js, TypeScript, Go, Python, Convex, Postgres, Stripe, and production AI APIs.

q3.question: How fast can we get to production?
q3.answer: Most commercial web apps and MVPs launch in 6 to 16 weeks, with high-impact landing systems and internal dashboards shipping even faster in focused sprints.

q4.question: What makes Masons different from a typical agency?
q4.answer: We think like product owners, not ticket takers. You work with the founding engineers, avoid bloated retainers, and get software engineered to earn its keep.

About.subtitle: Small by choice, obsessed with execution, and accountable for software that captures leads, moves revenue, and stays up under load.
About.storyLead: Masons is a Cairo product studio built by engineers who have shipped together for years. Businesses hire us when they need dependable software that converts customers and scales without burning months on bloated agencies.
About.storyP1: We started with a deep love for hard engineering problems, testing ourselves in public at NASA Space Apps Cairo (NAVERIS, Orbit), placing Top 7 at GDG Cairo's AI Finance Hackathon (repAI), and building our own AI product, Rafiqi. We remain proud of those roots because they forged our speed, discipline, and ability to ship under real pressure.
About.storyP2: Today, that same engineering edge powers commercial software: live business dashboards tracking 10M+ EGP in monthly client volume, high-converting web platforms, and AI automations that remove manual bottlenecks. Our technical approach is pragmatic: we choose proven tools matched to your business goals, timeline, and long-term margins.
About.storyP3: When you hire Masons, you sit side by side with the founding engineers. No account-manager telephone game, no padded timelines, and no vanishing after launch. We ship working software each week and stay invested in the numbers your product produces.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.scopeNote: Applies to wearemasons.com and project inquiries
PrivacyPage.intro: Plain language on what we collect when you visit our site or send a brief, how we protect commercial details, and how you can remove your data at any time.

h1.title: Zero Data Resale
h1.desc: We do not sell, rent, or broker contact lists, project briefs, or visitor data to third parties.

h2.title: Confidential Briefs & NDAs
h2.desc: Specs, revenue figures, and internal workflows shared with us stay private. Mutual NDAs are signed before scoping on request.

h3.title: Minimal Browser Footprint
h3.desc: No ad retargeting pixels or cross-site trackers. Your browser stores only your display theme and language choice.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect only the information required to answer inquiries, scope client builds, and keep this website operational.
s1.p1: Contact form and email details you submit: your name, email address, optional company name, project category, and brief.
s1.p2: Basic hosting request logs (such as IP address, browser type, and timestamp) recorded by our infrastructure provider for uptime and abuse protection.
s1.p3: Project documents, links, or credentials you choose to share during discovery or active engineering engagements.

s2.title: How We Use Your Information
s2.body: Your details are used for clear operational purposes tied to your request.
s2.p1: Replying to project inquiries, preparing scope proposals, and scheduling discovery calls.
s2.p2: Delivering contracted software builds, staging previews, invoicing, and post-launch support.
s2.p3: Protecting the site and contact endpoint against spam, automated abuse, and unauthorized access.

s3.title: Client Confidentiality & NDAs
s3.body: We treat product ideas, commercial metrics, customer data models, and architecture notes shared during inquiries as confidential business information. Access is limited to founding Masons engineers involved in evaluating or building your project. If your company requires a mutual NDA before sharing full specifications, email us first and we will execute one prior to discovery.

s4.title: Storage, Infrastructure & Retention
s4.body: Contact form submissions travel over encrypted HTTPS and encrypted email transport into our private team inbox. We rely on vetted infrastructure providers for hosting and email delivery. Inquiry records are retained only as long as needed to handle ongoing discussions, active contracts, or legal accounting obligations.

s5.title: Cookies & Local Browser Preferences
s5.body: This website avoids third-party advertising cookies and behavioral tracking scripts. We use lightweight browser storage (localStorage) to remember your chosen light or dark theme and standard routing cookies or URL prefixes to keep your selected language (English, Arabic, or French) consistent as you browse.

s6.title: Your Data Rights
s6.body: Regardless of where your company operates, you stay in control of the information you share with Masons.
s6.p1: Request a copy of the personal contact records or inquiry messages we hold for you.
s6.p2: Ask us to correct inaccurate contact or billing details.
s6.p3: Request deletion of your inquiry emails and attachments once no active contract or legal retention requirement applies.

s7.title: Policy Updates
s7.body: As we expand our studio services or adopt new infrastructure, we may update this policy. Material revisions will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.
